summary: Comprehensive lead research for auto detailing booking platforms in Ashtabula County. Consolidated findings from two research passes identifying 9 unique auto detailing businesses ranging from premium ceramic coating specialists to mobile detailing services, self-serve car washes, and full-service detail shops.

leads.fit_rationale: TOP PRIORITY: Premium detailing business with 20+ years experience, 9+ years ceramic coating expertise. Multi-certified professionals. High-ticket services ($799-$2099) with strong margins for tech investment. 100+ reviews, active social media, professional website. Owner Jonathan is tech-savvy and responsive.
leads.research_notes: Confirmed both research passes. Best overall fit for booking platform.

leads.location: Ashtabula County (Saybrook, North Kingsville, Conneaut, Geneva, Madison)
leads.fit_rationale: Mobile detailing service covering wide Ashtabula County area. Tiered service packages from basic to luxury. Currently phone/email only booking—highest pain point for mobile operators who can't answer calls while working.
leads.research_notes: From subagent research. Strong geographic fit.

leads.fit_rationale: Mobile detailing service based in Ashtabula. Mobile operators have highest need for automated booking since they can't answer phones while working on vehicles. Convenience-focused business model aligns with automated scheduling.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: MVP requires visual analysis to determine current branding state. Target audience is auto detailing businesses and car owners in Ashtabula County.

issues: No specific business entity identified - uses generic 'Local Auto Detail' placeholder
Dark theme with grid background looks like a design draft
Left-aligned narrow container creates unprofessional appearance
Lacks trust signals (testimonials, contact info, security badges)
strengths: Functional booking form structure is sound
Clear value proposition for AI-generated confirmations

site_improvements: Add real-time availability calendar showing open appointment slots
Implement service package selection with visual pricing tiers
Add vehicle type/size selection affecting pricing
Include before/after photo gallery showcasing detailing results
Integrate Google Maps for business location display
Add customer review and rating system
Implement SMS/email confirmation and reminder system
Create loyalty program/rewards for repeat customers
Add mobile-responsive design for on-the-go booking
Add weather contingency notifications for mobile detailers
Remove grid background and implement clean solid background
Center main content container with max-width constraint
Add primary brand color and logo for target detailing business
Add trust signals: testimonials, contact info, service guarantees

possible_issues: Ensure high-quality vehicle imagery is used throughout
Verify booking form is optimized for mobile devices
Check that pricing displays clearly with no hidden fees
Ensure color scheme conveys cleanliness and professionalism
Current dark theme is acceptable but needs accent colors
Consider premium blue/silver palette that conveys 'clean' and 'professional'
Vertical rhythm is inconsistent - increase padding between form sections
Primary CTA buttons need more prominence with contrasting colors

whitelabel_potential.reason: Auto detailing booking platform is highly replicable across different geographic markets. Core functionality (scheduling, service packages, quotes) applies universally to car care businesses. Easy to customize with local business branding, service areas, and pricing structures.
adaptable_for: Other vehicle service providers (tire shops, oil change, etc.)
